# prepare_inputs { #valley_floor.prepare_inputs }

`prepare_inputs`

Optional streamkit-based workflow for preparing inputs to map_valley_floor.

This module demonstrates one way to produce the four raster inputs required
by the core algorithm (dem, hand, channel_network, subbasins) from a DEM and
a vector flowlines dataset. It requires streamkit as an optional dependency:

    pip install "valley-floor[streamkit] @ git+https://github.com/avkoehl/valley-floor.git"

Users with their own hydrological preprocessing workflows do not need this
module — they can pass their own dem, hand, channel_network, and subbasins
directly to map_valley_floor.

## Functions

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [prepare_inputs](#valley_floor.prepare_inputs.prepare_inputs) | Prepare inputs for map_valley_floor using streamkit. |

### prepare_inputs { #valley_floor.prepare_inputs.prepare_inputs }

```python
prepare_inputs.prepare_inputs(
    dem,
    flowlines,
    reach_penalty=5,
    reach_min_length=1000,
    reach_smooth_window=5,
    reach_threshold_degrees=1.0,
)
```

Prepare inputs for map_valley_floor using streamkit.

Produces dem, hand, channel_network, and subbasins from a raw DEM and
vector flowlines. The returned dem is the original input — it is not
hydrologically conditioned. HAND and subbasins are derived from a
conditioned DEM internally.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                    | Type             | Description                                                                       | Default    |
|-------------------------|------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| dem                     | xr.DataArray     | Raw digital elevation model.                                                      | _required_ |
| flowlines               | gpd.GeoDataFrame | Vector stream network as a GeoDataFrame of LineStrings.                           | _required_ |
| reach_penalty           | int              | PELT penalty for reach segmentation. Higher values produce fewer, longer reaches. | `5`        |
| reach_min_length        | int              | Minimum reach length in meters.                                                   | `1000`     |
| reach_smooth_window     | int              | Window size for smoothing slope before segmentation.                              | `5`        |
| reach_threshold_degrees | float            | Merge adjacent reaches if slope difference is below this threshold in degrees.    | `1.0`      |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                                     |
|--------|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | xr.DataArray | Tuple of (dem, hand, channel_network, subbasins), ready to pass |
|        | xr.DataArray | directly to map_valley_floor.                                   |
